notes.call_ceiling: The run's process made its calls under the default process call ceiling, 2000 calls (EXULANICA_BUDGET_MAX_CALLS unset; DEFAULT_MAX_CALLS in exulanica/models/budget.py). The pre-registration and the admission between seeds counted dollars only.
notes.held_out_seeds: The held-out seeds of society-comparison-seeds.v4 are spent: every seed's anchors and three seeds' model runs were played. A comparison judged after this one runs on seeds drawn afresh.
